description: Search for a hotel by name within Fold service areas (Los Angeles and San Francisco). Returns up to 6 hotels matching the query with their place IDs (used in book_hotel_pickup) and addresses. book_hotel_pickup requires one of these hotelPlaceIds.

query.description: Hotel name or address. Minimum 2 characters. Example: "Four Seasons Beverly Hills" or "Marriott San Francisco".

name: search_hotels
title: Search hotels
